The public Mod-system entry point is `src/shell/src/mod-system/index.ts`.

The following symbols are exported or implemented by that entry point:

- `ModLoader`
- `Mod`
- `BlockEvent`
- `resolveCurrentWorkspace`
- `extractWorkspaceId`
- `createBlockAdapter`
- `ModDependency`
- `ModManifest`
- `BlockHandle`
- `SlotHandle`
- `ButtonHandle`
- `HubConfig`
- `SettingsSectionConfig`
- `SchemaComponentProps`
- `SchemaComponentRegistration`
- `RouteConfig`
- `ServiceConfig`
- `SchemaColumnDef`
- `SchemaTypeConfig`
- `WorkspaceConfig`
- `CurrentWorkspace`
- `ActionCatalogEntry`
- `SlotContext`
- `BlockInstance`
- `BlockComponentProps`
- `BlockRegistration`
- `ButtonRegistration`
- `SlotDeclaration`
- `SlotBinding`
- `BaseBinding`
- `BlockBinding`
- `ButtonBinding`
- `RendererProps`
- `IconLibraryEntry`
- `ColorToken`
- `parseJsonManifest`
- `Mod.id`
- `Mod.registerFormulaFunction`
- `Mod.registerBlock`
- `Mod.declareSlot`
- `Mod.registerButton`
- `Mod.registerIntoSlot`
- `Mod.resolveSlot`
